about_the_game:
The king has exiled his brother for treason (or so we are told). You are an army General returning from a long trip, tasked with defending the kings city against his brothers attacks. In this strategical resource management tower defense, you will die...Eventually. There is no end to the eternal waves of attacks, but how long can you survive? Can you outlive the human era and reach the leaderboard?

Manage resources and upgrades

Invent the fastest, most efficient resource management path. Maybe even sacrifice some early towers to get upgrades faster...at your own risk.

Never-ending chaos

There are no wave timers, no breaks - the armies keep on coming, and they will never stop until they take over the city.

Use your spells wisely

You may brute force with only tower damage, but why not survive even longer with proper upgrades and efficient spell management? Every kill counts for the leaderboard spot!

** Generative AI was not used in the making or any promotion of Eternal Siege

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 v1909
  • Processor: intel i5-4570
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended minimum resolution: 1920x1080 but playable on as low as 1280x720, however text may be small
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Latest version of Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: intel i7-9700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2070 (1440p ultra settings 120fps)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The UI looks best on 1440p, however there is also UI scaling option available in the settings menu

short_description: Eternal Siege is a tower defense game based around resource management, efficient use of spells, upgrading systems, and (hopefully) building some towers. Start in the Ancient Greek era, and develop a strategy to survive the human extinction to battle for the top of the leaderboard.
